title: CP 140.03 : wages and bonuses 2026
summary: Apply the scale corresponding to mobile staff, non-mobile staff or garage staff and the compensatory rest regime. The collective agreement of December 18, 2025 sets the amounts as of January 1, 2026.
body: The collective agreement 196981/CO/140.03 applies to workers in ONSS category 083. For level 1 mobile staff, the minimum gross is 14.5425 €/hour with paid compensatory rest, versus 14.9255 €/hour with unpaid rest or 38 effective hours per week. At level 4, the corresponding rates are 15.4020 € and 15.8075 €.

For non-mobile class 1 staff, the rates are 15.2435 € and 15.6465 €/hour respectively. The annex provides for a shift bonus of 7.5 % of the hourly wage scale per hour actually worked, excluding garage staff, and a night bonus of 12.5 % for non-mobile staff.

Check the conditions for opening bonuses and, for new hires concerned, the night rules that came into force on June 1, 2026. The offer must distinguish base salary, bonuses and expense reimbursements.

title: CP 226 : employee scales in 2026
summary: Determine the job class and seniority level before pricing the offer. Minimum monthly amounts have been indexed by 2.23 % as of January 1, 2026.
body: With zero seniority, the minimum monthly gross at full-time is 2,574.27 € in class 1, 2,810.29 € in class 2 and 3,755.40 € in class 8. The amounts apply to the company's full-time schedule; for part-time, apply the ratio between the contracted hours and that schedule.

An employee who usually performs functions from multiple classes receives the compensation of the highest function. The page provides special spreading rules for certain promotions of at least two classes. Do not infer the class solely from the job title.

owner.name: SPF Emploi, Travail et Concertation sociale

title: CP 111 : worker minima since July 2026
summary: Check the territorial table and hourly schedule for metal processing companies. The official database shows an indexation of 2.81 % as of July 1, 2026.
body: The national table shows 17.1244 € gross/hour for a 38-hour-per-week schedule as of July 1, 2026. The sheet excludes bridge assembly and metal framework companies from the wage scale collective agreement presented.

Separate territorial tables and classifications are in the same sheet. For example, Brabant shows 16.6853 €/hour for 39 hours and 16.2682 €/hour for 40 hours. Confirm the applicable table before publishing the compensation of a welder, operator or technician; do not apply a single rate to all of CP 111.

owner.name: SPF Emploi, Travail et Concertation sociale

title: CP 209 : employee minima since July 2026
summary: Employees with wage scales and wage-scale eligible in metal fabrication fall under the national minima of their category. The indexation as of July 1, 2026 is 2.81 %.
body: For administrative employees, the minimum monthly gross as of July 1, 2026 are 2,648.62 € at steps 1 and 2, 2,756.34 € at step 3 and 2,948.60 € at step 4.

The sheet distinguishes administrative employees, technical employees, drafters, supervisors and boilermakers' tracers. Identify the actual category and verify company conditions before announcing a salary. The national scale only covers employees with wage scales and wage-scale eligible; the page clarifies that sector indexation applies to minima and actual wages.

owner.name: SPF Emploi, Travail et Concertation sociale

title: Truck driver: check C and CE licenses
summary: The offer must request the category corresponding to the truck and its trailer. Also check the medical fitness of group 2 and the CAP when the activity requires it.
body: Category C license authorizes vehicles over 3,500 kg maximum authorized mass; C1 covers those over 3,500 kg and up to 7,500 kg. With C or C1, the trailer cannot exceed 750 kg. Beyond that, the appropriate complementary category CE or C1E is required.

According to the page updated February 20, 2026, C and CE can be obtained from age 18 with professional aptitude, versus 21 without it. To request the license, a medical certificate of group 2 is required among other things. Check the validity of the categories listed on the candidate's document, not just past exam success.

title: Code 95 : renewal and regional competence
summary: Code 95 supplements the license for most professional drivers. Plan for five-year renewal and direct procedures to the competent Region.
body: Information published by the Walloon Regional Service on June 2, 2025 confirms regionalization of exams and continuing education related to professional aptitude. The certificate applies to most professional drivers of categories C and D.

Renewal takes place every five years after 35 hours of continuing education. In recruitment, request a valid code 95 or clearly identify the applicable exemption; arrange training as the deadline approaches. EU rules on initial and continuing qualification are codified by directive EU 2022/2561; concrete procedures fall to regional authorities.
source: Walloon Regional Service Mobility and Infrastructure · mobilite.wallonie.be

title: Truck drivers: driving, breaks and rest
summary: Construct the routes and schedules announced while respecting the driving limits and rest periods of regulation EC 561/2006. Driving time does not represent all working time.
body: The European sheet verified July 12, 2026 recalls the limits of 9 hours of driving per day, extensible to 10 hours twice per week, 56 hours per week and 90 hours over two consecutive weeks. After 4.5 hours of driving, plan for 45 minutes of break, possibly split into 15 then 30 minutes.

Normal daily rest is 11 hours; reduction to 9 hours is possible a maximum of three times between two weekly rest periods. Normal weekly rest of 45 hours must not be taken in the vehicle and the employer bears the cost of required accommodation.

Also plan loading, unloading and other tasks in the schedule. European working time rules set an average of 48 hours per week, distinct from the driving limit. International transport exemptions must be checked before promising a route organization.

title: Tachograph: applicable requirements in 2026
summary: Check the vehicle equipment and train the driver in its use. As of July 1, 2026, the obligation extends to certain international goods transport in light vehicles.
body: The Federal Mobility and Transport page, updated June 30, 2026, requires a smart tachograph version 2 for newly registered vehicles since August 21, 2023. For vehicles used in international transport, replacement of old analog or digital tachographs was required by January 1, 2025, and that of smart version 1 by August 18, 2025.

As of July 1, 2026, international goods transport in vehicles over 2.5 tonnes and up to 3.5 tonnes also fall under the scheme. The page recalls the exemption of article 3, point ha, of regulation 561/2006 for certain own-account transport when driving is not the main activity.

Qualify the activity before deciding on an exemption and verify that the driver is proficient with the installed tachograph. The Belgian derogation from the electric pilot project mentioned on the page ended August 31, 2026; do not present it as still applicable on September 30, 2026.

title: Forklift operator: training and medical fitness
summary: Belgian regulations do not establish a general forklift operator license. The employer must verify training appropriate to the equipment and medical fitness for the safety-critical position.
body: Article IV.3-7, 1°, of the Wellbeing Code reserves the operation of self-propelled mobile equipment to workers trained in their safe operation. The operator holds a safety-critical position within the meaning of article I.4-1, § 2, 1°; occupational medicine confirms fitness.

A certificate issued by a training organization can document competencies, but the employment service does not require mandatory accreditation of these courses or a regulatory forklift license. In the job posting, specify the type of equipment and expected competency, then verify that training matches the assigned tasks.

The employment service recalls the general prohibition for students and the existence of framed exceptions for certain non-stacking low-lifting equipment. The reference date is the entry into force of the Code on June 12, 2017; it is not an update date for this page.

owner.name: SPF Emploi, Travail et Concertation sociale

title: Machines: instructions and specific training
summary: Before assigning an operator or technician, check the position's risks, required instructions and authorizations. Prior experience does not exempt the employer from these obligations.
body: Book IV, Title 2, of the Code requires equipment appropriate for the work and risks. Article IV.2-3 reserves use presenting specific risk to workers assigned to that use; those involved in repair, modification, maintenance or upkeep must be specifically authorized.

Article IV.2-4 requires appropriate specific training for these workers. Article IV.2-5 requires understandable information covering normal use, foreseeable abnormal situations and lessons learned from experience, as well as written instructions for machinery and mechanized tools. Plan this preparation in position onboarding.
The official PDF notes the amending decree of May 12, 2024, published in the Belgian Official Gazette on June 10, 2024. This publication serves as the documentary reference date.

owner.name: SPF Emploi, Travail et Concertation sociale

title: Welder: scope of ISO 9606-1 qualification
summary: For a steel welding function, verify that the requested qualification corresponds to the job process. ISO 9606-1:2012 remains published; the draft ISO/DIS 9606.2 does not yet constitute its definitive replacement.
body: ISO 9606-1:2012 defines the qualification test for fusion welding of steels, manual or semi-automatic. It assesses notably the welder's ability to guide the electrode, torch or blowpipe to produce an acceptable weld. It does not apply to fully mechanized or automated processes.

The ISO sheet indicates confirmation of the edition in 2023 and presents the next edition as a draft. In the job posting, specify the qualification corresponding to the work, rather than indiscriminately request certification for any process. Separately verify project or client requirements: the technical sheet does not by itself create a general legal obligation for access to the profession.

title: Night work: rules since June 2026
summary: Use the current rules of the law of March 16, 1971, not old e-commerce summaries. Since June 1, 2026, night work is permitted in principle.
body: Night remains defined as 8 p.m. to 6 a.m. The employer must observe rest periods, collective agreements, prevention and the procedure for introducing into work rules. Distinguish schedules outside midnight-5 a.m., under article 36, from regimes with night work under article 38.

In distribution and legally defined related sectors, including certain logistics activities, night bonus rights for new entrants since June 1, 2026 are limited to work between 11 p.m. and 6 a.m., except for collective or regulatory derogation coming into force after that date. Workers already employed retain their applicable rights between 8 p.m. and 6 a.m.
Before publishing schedules and bonuses, check the scope, the worker's situation and collective agreements. Night authorization does not exempt from the procedure for introducing the regime.

owner.name: SPF Emploi, Travail et Concertation sociale

title: Warehouse: check Sunday work authorization
summary: Sunday work requires an applicable derogation for the activity. Mere candidate agreement or mentioning 'Sunday work' in the job posting is not sufficient.
body: Article 11 of the law of March 16, 1971 generally prohibits work on Sunday from 0 to 24 hours. The employment service lists derogations notably for land transport companies and certain loading or unloading in ports, docks and stations. Check the legal basis specific to the warehouse rather than automatically extending a transport exception to all storage activity.

In principle, Sunday work opens compensatory rest within the following six days. According to article 16, more than four hours of work entitles to a full day; up to four hours, a half-day, before or after 1 p.m., with a maximum of five hours of work that day.
The documentary date corresponds to publication of the base law on March 30, 1971. For the job posting, confirm the current regime and any sector bonuses.

owner.name: SPF Emploi, Travail et Concertation sociale

title: Temp work: pay and schedules at the user company
summary: The temporary worker must receive at least the compensation they would receive as a permanent worker under the same conditions. The user company's schedule rules apply to the assignment.
body: Compensation also includes benefits granted to permanent workers. For an assignment in logistics or manufacturing, transmit to the agency the classification, salary and bonuses applicable at the user company. Overtime, night and Sunday work also follow the user company's regulations with the same bonuses and compensatory rest.

Only an approved temporary work agency can provide this service. Check the authorized reason, duration and required agreements before the assignment. The employment service notably prohibits temp workers in case of strike or lockout at the facility and for the category of personnel concerned.
The reference date is publication of the law of July 24, 1987 in the Belgian Official Gazette of August 20, 1987; the official sheet presents the scheme and its amendments.

owner.name: SPF Emploi, Travail et Concertation sociale

title: Temp work: communicate position risks
summary: The user company must communicate the position qualifications and risks before selecting the temporary worker. The job sheet enables the agency to select a person fit for the assigned tasks.
body: Before placement, the user company describes professional requirements and wellbeing information via the job sheet. The temporary work agency selects the worker on this basis and transmits received information before their assignment.

During the assignment, the user company is responsible for applying wellbeing rules on site. For a forklift operator, production operator or welder, document actual equipment and risks; do not assign the worker to another risky activity without reexamining this information. Articles 12ter and 12quater of the Wellbeing Law require refusing a collaboration known not to meet these obligations.
The framework is in Book X, Title 2, of the Wellbeing Code, which entered into force on June 12, 2017. This date serves as reference absent an update date.

owner.name: SPF Emploi, Travail et Concertation sociale

title: Posted drivers: declaration and documents
summary: For road posting to Belgium, use the transport-specific declaration. It replaces the Limosa declaration in this scheme's scope.
body: An employer established in the European Union or the United Kingdom declares the posting before it starts via the public interface linked to IMI and keeps the data current. For an employer established elsewhere, the employment service indicates the Belgian application transport-declaration-detachement.belgique.be. The declaration also identifies the transport manager or contact person.

The driver must be able to present the declaration, proof of transport operations and tachograph recordings, on paper or electronically. After posting, the employer must provide documents requested by inspection within eight weeks of the request.

The Belgian framework transposes the Mobility Package by the law of June 19, 2022, published July 11, 2022. First verify that the operation constitutes posting subject to the scheme; do not treat every border crossing as posting.
